prompt: Name a part of the human body that counts as an organ

answers.name: Brain
answers.fact: Uses about 20% of the body's energy.

answers.name: Lungs
answers.fact: Their surface area is roughly the size of a tennis court.

answers.name: Liver
answers.fact: Can regrow from as little as a quarter of itself.

answers.name: Kidneys
answers.fact: Filter about 180 litres of blood a day.

answers.name: Stomach
answers.fact: Gets a new lining every few days, so acid doesn't digest it.

answers.name: Intestines
answers.fact: The small intestine is about six metres long.

answers.name: Eyes
answers.fact: Can tell apart around a million colours.

answers.name: Appendix
answers.fact: Long called useless, but it may store good gut bacteria.

answers.name: Thyroid
answers.fact: A butterfly-shaped gland in the neck.

answers.name: Ears
answers.fact: Hold the smallest bones in the body.

answers.name: Nose
answers.fact: Can detect a vast number of smells.

answers.name: Uterus
answers.fact: Can stretch to many times its size in pregnancy.

answers.name: Ovaries
answers.fact: Hold all the eggs a person will have, from birth.

answers.name: Testes
answers.fact: Kept outside the body to stay cooler.

answers.name: Prostate
answers.fact: A gland the size of a walnut.

answers.name: Pituitary gland
answers.fact: The 'master gland', the size of a pea.

answers.name: Spinal cord
answers.fact: Carries signals between brain and body.

answers.name: Thymus
answers.fact: Trains immune cells; shrinks with age.

answers.name: Diaphragm
answers.fact: The main muscle of breathing; often counted as an organ.

answers.name: Rectum
answers.fact: The last stretch of the large intestine.

answers.name: Duodenum
answers.fact: The first part of the small intestine.

answers.name: Placenta
answers.fact: The only organ the body grows temporarily.

answers.name: Salivary glands
answers.fact: Make about a litre of spit a day.

answers.name: Teeth
answers.fact: Enamel is the hardest substance in the body.

answers.name: Cerebellum
answers.fact: The 'little brain', for balance and coordination.

answers.name: Urethra
answers.fact: Carries urine out of the body.

answers.name: Jejunum
answers.fact: The middle part of the small intestine.

answers.name: Ileum
answers.fact: The last part of the small intestine.

answers.name: Caecum
answers.fact: A pouch where the appendix attaches.

answers.name: Epiglottis
answers.fact: A flap that stops food going down the windpipe.

answers.name: Retina
answers.fact: A thin layer of light-sensing cells.

answers.name: Epididymis
answers.fact: A coiled tube about six metres long.

answers.name: Seminal vesicles
answers.fact: Glands that add fluid to semen.

answers.name: Corpus callosum
answers.fact: Joins the two halves of the brain.

answers.name: Sigmoid colon
answers.fact: An S-shaped part of the colon.

answers.name: Omentum
answers.fact: A fatty apron over the gut.

answers.name: Alveoli
answers.fact: Hundreds of millions of tiny air sacs.

answers.name: Uvula
answers.fact: The dangly bit at the back of the throat.

answers.name: Vomeronasal organ
answers.fact: A smell organ that may not work in humans.

answers.name: Islets of Langerhans
answers.fact: Clusters of insulin cells in the pancreas.
